headline: Base Rate Heading Toward 3.5%, the 'Post-COVID High': Will It Again Pressure Home Prices and Trading Volume?
summary: The Bank of Korea has raised its base rate for two consecutive months. Further hikes at the remaining policy meetings this year could bring the rate close to 3.5%, the level of the past property adjustment.
why: The Bank of Korea sets the policy rate that anchors borrowing costs across the economy. Mortgage rates and property transaction volumes are sensitive to changes in it.
